correctness.rationale: Boundary eigenmodes solve the coupled active/inactive killed backward equations; active boundary has opposite signed approach marks and inactive solution is C1 at the transparent interface. Retained-gate Poisson-reset renewal K-L identity follows by subtracting post-capture gate occupancy. Its unique two-by-two solution simplifies to the proposed formulas. Strict reset monotonicity follows from decreasing positive factors. Both r→0 and fixed-x0 r→infinity expansions are checked. The packaged high-precision independent renewal calculation and exact Brownian-bridge event simulation passed 2346 programmatic checks. Finite tests supplement but do not prove the theorem.

value.rationale: The source specifically studies from which side a temporally available target is first contacted, but only through simulation. The closed-form split, rigorous strict improvement under every reset rate, universal 1/r wrong-side rarity independent of opening rate/diffusivity/distance, and nonanalytic weak-reset susceptibility furnish physically interpretable, parameter-free calibration not inferable from the unmarked mean hitting time alone. These are model-specific structural assertions, not arbitrary tabulated cases.
